<span class="hl-kw">export</span> <span class="hl-kw">interface</span> UserCreatedData {
  payload: {
    a: <span class="hl-type">string</span>;
    b?: <span class="hl-type">number</span>;
  } | {
    c?: <span class="hl-type">boolean</span>;
  };
  value: <span class="hl-type">string</span> | <span class="hl-type">number</span> | <span class="hl-type">boolean</span>;
  dup?: <span class="hl-type">number</span>;
  listOf?: (<span class="hl-type">string</span> | <span class="hl-type">null</span>)[];
  nullFirst?: <span class="hl-type">null</span> | <span class="hl-type">string</span>;
  allNull?: <span class="hl-type">null</span>;
  nestedAny?: <span class="hl-type">string</span> | <span class="hl-type">number</span> | <span class="hl-type">boolean</span>;
  plain?: <span class="hl-type">string</span>;
}
